description: A Director of Operations must set the roles, workload, and meeting schedule for a six-week process-improvement sprint involving two employees who volunteered to lead it.

shared_context.S1: The operations team is launching a six-week sprint to improve the handoff between Customer Support and Operations.
shared_context.S2: The sprint needs one accountable lead, one supporting reviewer, a weekly working session, and a written outcome at the end.
shared_context.S3: Evan and Rina both volunteered to help run the sprint.
shared_context.S4: Mara makes the binding role and schedule decision.
shared_context.S5: The department's routine planning process is to hear each volunteer's role preferences, current commitments, and practical constraints before assigning the work.

PF1.text: Evan has not completed the department's facilitation training and has asked his manager to let him shadow rather than lead live working sessions; for this sprint, he can serve as the reviewer and documentation owner but should not be the accountable lead.

PF2.text: Rina promised her current support team that she would continue running its customer-escalation clinic every Tuesday throughout the six-week sprint; she can lead the sprint if its weekly working session is scheduled on Thursday and her sprint allocation is capped at 6 hours per week.

acceptance_conditions: Rina must be the accountable sprint lead.
Evan must be the supporting reviewer and documentation owner.
The weekly working session must occur on Thursday.
Rina's sprint allocation must be exactly 6 hours per week.
A written sprint outcome must be required.
The settlement must explicitly use a private fact that its owner disclosed.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'role_assignment' and c['target'] == 'Evan' and 'supporting reviewer' in c['detail'] and 'documentation owner' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: Evan's incomplete facilitation training changes his assignment from a generic co-lead or lead role to exactly the supporting reviewer and documentation owner.
Rina's Tuesday clinic commitment changes the accountable lead to Rina, moves the working session to Thursday, and fixes her sprint allocation at exactly 6 hours per week.
